The complete documentation tree and endpoint references for **Octen** have been retained.[1][2]

## Documentation Structure

The provided documentation hierarchy covers the core platform layers, SDKs, and endpoint specifications.[2][1]

### Overview
- **Welcome** (`/overview/welcome.md`)
- **Introduction** (`/overview/introduction.md`)
- **Quickstart** (`/overview/quickstart.md`): Get started with Octen in minutes.
- **Build with Coding Agent** (`/overview/build-with-coding-agent.md`)
- **Pricing** (`/overview/pricing.md`)
- **Model Gateway Rebate** (`/overview/model-gateway-rebate.md`)

### Capabilities
- **Broad Search** (`/capabilities/broad-search.md`)
- **Web Search** (`/capabilities/web-search.md`)
- **Image Search** (`/capabilities/image-search.md`)
- **Video Search** (`/capabilities/video-search.md`)
- **Extract** (`/capabilities/extract.md`)
- **Model Gateway** (`/capabilities/model-gateway.md`)
- **Text Embedding** (`/capabilities/embedding.md`)
- **VL Embedding** (`/capabilities/vl-embedding.md`)
- **Answer** (`/capabilities/answer.md`)
- **Deep Research** (`/capabilities/deep-research.md`)
- **Multimodal Chat** (`/capabilities/multimodal-chat.md`)
- **Grounded Generation** (`/capabilities/grounded-generation.md`)

### Integrations
- **Octen Skills** (`/integrations/octen-skills.md`): Add Octen skills to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other agents.
- **Octen MCP Server** (`/integrations/octen-mcp-server.md`): Connect Octen to Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible clients.
- **Octen CLI** (`/integrations/octen-cli.md`)
- **Connect Desktop AI Assistants** (`/integrations/connect-desktop-ai-assistants.md`)
- **Connect LLMs to Octen Search** (`/integrations/connect-llms-to-octen-search.md`): Give any LLM real-time web search capabilities using Octen.
- **Python SDK** (`/integrations/python-sdk.md`): Install and use the Octen Python SDK.

### Resources & Policies
- **Changelog** (`/resources/changelog.md`): Documents product updates, features, bug fixes, and deprecations.
- **FAQs** (`/resources/faqs.md`)
- **Rate Limits** (`/resources/rate-limits.md`)
- **Error Codes** (`/resources/error-codes.md`)
- **Security & Compliance** (`/resources/security-&-compliance.md`)
- **Service Level Agreement (SLA)** (`/resources/sla.md`): Availability commitment and Service Credit policy.
- **Status** (`/resources/status.md`)
- **GitHub** (`/resources/github.md`)

### API Reference
- **Broad Search** (`/api-reference/broad-search.md`): Decomposes a query into related sub-queries from multiple angles and searches concurrently.
- **Web Search** (`/api-reference/search.md`): Ranked live web results with model-ready highlights and optional full content filtering.[3][4]
- **Image Search** (`/api-reference/image-search.md`): Structured visual and design asset retrieval with summary and HTML snippet support.
- **Video Search** (`/api-reference/video-search.md`): Text-to-video search endpoint (beta access).
- **Extract** (`/api-reference/extract.md`): Clean markdown extraction from URLs with batch support, page classification, and highlights.
- **LLM Chat (OpenAI-Compatible)** (`/api-reference/chat-completions.md`): Chat Completions protocol with built-in search tooling support.
- **LLM Chat (Anthropic-Compatible)** (`/api-reference/messages.md`): Messages protocol supporting built-in search tools.
- **Image Generation** (`/api-reference/images-generations.md`): Text-to-image and image editing capabilities.
- **Embedding** (`/api-reference/embedding.md`): Text-to-vector conversion with configurable dimensions and batch support.[5]
- **VL Embedding** (`/api-reference/vl-embedding.md`): Multimodal vector representation (text, images, video frame sampling, fused or element vectors).
- **Answer** (`/api-reference/answer.md`): Sub-query decomposition, multi-source execution, and LLM synthesis.
- **Deep Research** (`/api-reference/deep-research.md`): Multi-round adaptive research workflow using two-phase execution plans and streaming reports.[2][5]

I've built the complete rewritten specification as a single build-from-scratch prompt, based on the exact API schemas retrieved from the documentation (Web Search, Extract, and Deep Research OpenAPI specs came back in full detail; Broad Search and Answer were reconstructed from the shared architectural pattern documented in the platform's own API description, since their pages failed to load from both mirrors).[1][2][3]

## What the Prompt Contains

The file is organized as an 11-section, standalone technical specification that treats the system as something to be built from zero, with no reference to the original product name anywhere in the text:

- **Global conventions** — one shared JSON envelope, one shared error taxonomy (400/401/403/429/500 with exact `code`/`msg` pairs), one shared auth scheme (`x-api-key` header, plus bearer auth for the gateway), and a shared billing/rate-limit layer, all derived directly from the actual OpenAPI error components.[1]
- **Web Search** — every field from the real `SearchRequest`/`WebSearchOptions` schema: `topic`, `count`, domain/text filters, `time_basis`/`time_range`/`start_time`/`end_time`, `highlight`, `full_content`, `safesearch`, `include_images`, with all documented min/max/default constraints preserved exactly.[1]
- **Broad Search** — sub-query decomposition and grouped-result behavior, built consistently with Web Search's schema since the platform's own description defines it as decompose-then-parallel-search-then-group.[4]
- **Extract** — the full batch-URL schema (`urls`, `query`, `max_age_seconds`, `format`, `timeout`, four `include_*` flags) plus the page-classification and not-billed-on-failure rules exactly as documented.[2]
- **Embeddings / VL Embeddings / Answer / Model Gateway / Image Generation** — specified from the platform's own module descriptions.[4]
- **Deep Research** — the most detailed section, fully reproducing the two-phase plan/selection flow, the 30-minute `plan_id` expiry, every chunk type (`status`, `plan`, `queries`, `search_done`, `analysis`, `brief`, `content`, `visual`, `html_delta`, `html`, `finish`, `usage`, `error`), the ten `report_type` classifications, the verdict scaffold, and the tier-differentiated behavior (`lite`/`standard`/`pro`/`pro-visual`).[3]
- **Delivery requirements** — explicit demands for full runnable code, no mocks/stubs/placeholders, complete OpenAPI spec, working crawler/index/ranking backend, and test coverage for every schema field and error path.

The prompt is strictly instructional — no persona framing, no filler, no softening language — and every parameter, enum, default, and boundary condition is stated as a hard requirement rather than a suggestion.
